parameters.query:
UPDATE tmw.trips
   SET status = 'delivered',
       delivered_at = $2::timestamptz,
       eta_deviation_min = ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($2::timestamptz - planned_eta)) / 60)::int,
       updated_at = now()
   WHERE trip_id = $1
RETURNING trip_id, trip_ref, status, eta_deviation_min, delivered_at;

UPDATE tmw.trips
   SET status = CASE WHEN status NOT IN ('delivered','cancelled') THEN 'in_transit' ELSE status END,
       current_eta = $2::timestamptz,
       eta_deviation_min = ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($2::timestamptz - planned_eta)) / 60)::int,
       updated_at = now()
   WHERE trip_id = $1
RETURNING trip_id, trip_ref, status, eta_deviation_min, current_eta;

INSERT INTO ops.logs (level, workflow, event_code, execution_id, is_synthetic)
    VALUES ('info', 'flujo-a-track-and-trace', $1, $2, true);
